findings.old: and erases it with rainwater and drinks from it, whoever has wretchedness in his heart, it will depart from him
findings.new: and erases it with rainwater, and someone with wretchedness in his heart drinks from it, that wretchedness will depart from him
findings.reason: ومحاه بماء المطر وشرب منه من به شقاوة في قلبه زالت عنه: من به شقاوة is the explicit subject of شرب; do not silently make the writer the drinker or leave the result subject unbound.

findings.old: dan menghapusnya dengan air hujan dan meminumnya, orang yang di dalam hatinya ada kesialan akan hilang darinya
findings.new: dan menghapusnya dengan air hujan, lalu orang yang di dalam hatinya ada kesengsaraan meminumnya, kesengsaraan itu akan hilang darinya
findings.reason: وشرب منه من به شقاوة في قلبه زالت عنه identifies the drinker as someone with wretchedness in his heart, and says the wretchedness departs. شقاوة is wretchedness/misery, not bad luck (kesialan); the existing syntax also makes the person disappear.

uncertainties: Source والرحم من وصلها والخوايم has an incomplete kinship clause and an unidentified al-khawāyim; both targets retain readable fragments with descriptive target-language uncertainty rather than replacing them.

findings.reason: ودامت محبته means his love endures; the possessive does not mean other people’s love toward him.

findings.old: God will restore to him every lost item and return every runaway slave.
findings.new: God will restore to him every lost item and every runaway slave missing from him.
findings.reason: رد الله له كل ضالة وأبق ضائع له restricts the runaway to one missing from/belonging to that person; the second له must not disappear.

findings.old: Allah akan mengembalikan kepadanya setiap barang yang hilang dan hamba yang melarikan diri.
findings.new: Allah akan mengembalikan kepadanya setiap barang yang hilang dan hamba pelariannya yang hilang darinya.
findings.reason: رد الله له كل ضالة وأبق ضائع له includes ضائع له, the runaway missing from him; retain the ownership/relation qualifier.

findings.old: it is written and drunk as an infusion
findings.new: it is written and given to drink
findings.reason: وهو يكتب ويسقى says written and given to drink; it does not specify an infusion (steeping preparation). Do not add a preparation method.
الرشيد denotes right guidance; the added absolute infallibility claim is not expressed by this Name in the source.
إلى أن ينقطع النفس means until the breath breaks off/ceases, not merely is held/restrained. Preserve the literal source condition without changing the operation.

findings.old: whoever seeks the Truth guards it from literal phrasings
findings.new: whoever seeks the Truth guards it from words
findings.reason: ومن أراد الحق يصونه عن الألفاظ says words/expressions without the limiting qualifier literal; preserve its unrestricted scope.

findings.old: barang siapa menghendaki Kebenaran sejati hendaklah memeliharanya dari sekadar lafal-lafal lahiriah
findings.new: barang siapa menghendaki Kebenaran hendaklah memeliharanya dari lafal-lafal
findings.reason: ومن أراد الحق يصونه عن الألفاظ: الألفاظ is unrestricted words/expressions. sekadar and lahiriah narrow the scope without Arabic support.
